XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Failure to start, sudden engine shutdown
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: engine management | injection | starting | ignition | hill holder | departures | climbing |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: All vehicles

  • System: - -

  • Device: Injection control unit

  • Fault: Failure to start, sudden engine shutdown. Hill start assist system malfunction (Hill Holder)

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Injection control unit software error

• Action: Check that the cause of the malfunction is not due to mechanical or electrical faults. If no faults are found, proceed with the software update of the injection control unit. Then perform the gearbox and phonic wheel learning procedure

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: To perform the software update, contact an authorised service centre. The learning procedure can be performed using dedicated diagnostic equipment.
